lines: Not many people walk out this far.
You're not from the town, are you?
0.note: A woman by the path. Polite, a little guarded.

reply: Outside town. The path takes you back.
Follow it west. No, east. East.

lines: Still walking? Good. Most people drive.
The lake? Colder than it looks.
People swim in it in summer. I don't.
1.note: Sigrún: the lake is cold. People swim in it in summer.

lines: Someone built it so the path can be found in fog.
Don't knock it over. People still use them.
1.note: Sigrún: stone piles mark the path in fog. Don't knock them over.
